name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 52 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: An AI skill that draws clean, professional-looking diagrams — flowcharts, architecture maps, and more — as a single self-contained file, so you get designer-quality visuals without hiring a designer.
buyer: A freelance consultant or startup founder who needs polished diagrams for pitch decks, documentation, or client reports but has no design budget.
business_use_cases: A freelance consultant produces client-ready architecture and process diagrams for proposals in minutes instead of hours in a design tool.
A technical documentation agency offers 'diagram refresh' packages to startups with outdated or ugly product docs.
A pitch-deck service adds AI-generated custom diagrams as a premium add-on for founders raising funding.

money_ideas.idea: A per-deliverable diagram design service sold to consultants and agencies
An 'unlimited diagram requests per month' subscription for startups

steal_this: Offer three startups a free diagram makeover for one slide of their pitch deck this week, then upsell a full deck refresh.
